Method of Attack: Loading a modified trustlet in the secure area by exploiting vulnerabilities CVE-2015-6639 and CVE-2016-2431 to patch the trustlet and bypass QSEOS verification
Executing a trustlet in the normal world and loading a modified variant in the secure world to fuzz and find vulnerabilities
Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Qualcomm's Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) implementation allowing access to critical data
Impacted Systems: Devices using Qualcomm's Trusted Execution Environment implementation
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Qualcomm's Secure World trustlet verification and loading process
Use of a loader to run trustlets in the normal world and patch them before loading in the secure world
